{{Quote|No, please, I beg you&mdash;!|Captain Gray's last words|<ref name="Voyage of Temptation">{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}}</ref>}}
'''Gray''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze's]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:Tal_MerrikCommandos.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Gray shortly before he was killed by Merrik]]
During the Duchess' voyage to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the traitorous [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik]] burst on to the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''Coronet'' with Satine as his hostage. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Gray was the last to be [[Death/Legends|killed]] after the [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]] under his command were eliminated. Before being shot by Merrik, he pleaded for his life, though it was in vain.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Gray was voiced by [[David Acord]] in "[[Voyage of Temptation]]."
